tweetMedia.transcription: Are you guys seeing what I'm seeing? Look. Do you see it? All these dudes. Look. What do they all have in common? What do they all have in common, guys? Devante Adams. Puka Nakua. Ben Skoranek. A-Rod. More and more athletes are finally starting to understand the danger behind wireless technology like Bluetooth headphones. You gotta protect the brain. I'm starting to think about that. Because the electromagnetic is going in there. This is not a conspiracy theory. There is legitimate science dating back to the 1960s showing that non-native electromagnetic fields can have detrimental impacts on plants, animals, and humans. And it's not just your headphones. It's your Wi-Fi, cell towers, cell phones, electronic devices, electric vehicles, power lines, the wiring inside your walls, the light emitted from your device screens, and more. In our modern environment, we are being inundated by these fields everywhere we go. And as technology continues to grow, this is the number one health problem we will all face.
